title: The two Turkish documents are rewritten in English
description:
`docs/PLAYBOOK.md` (185 lines) and `docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md` (217 lines) are written in Turkish; every other file in `docs/`, including `REVIEW-2026-08-28.md`, is English. Rewrite both in English, keeping every heading, table, ADR reference, file path and line citation exactly where it is — these are dated records of what was judged on those days, so the job is translation and never revision.

Two things stay Turkish and the node should not touch them: the Turkish strings in `packages/core/src/id.ts` and `packages/core/src/id.test.ts` are fixtures for the transliteration table and are the whole point of that test (`Ayrıştırma` → `ayristirma`), and the author's name in `LICENSE`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` and the three `plugin.json` files is a name.

Acceptance is a command: a search for Turkish-specific letters and a short Turkish word list over tracked files returns only those two exclusions.

brief.approach:
Translation, not revision. Two files, `docs/PLAYBOOK.md` (185 lines) and `docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md` (217 lines), rewritten in English in place. Same paths, same filenames — do not rename either, and do not add a note saying it was translated.

**What must survive byte-for-byte.** Every heading number, every table, every ADR reference, every `file:line` citation, every backticked path. Eight documents cite these two by section number and there are no markdown anchors anywhere — the references are plain `§N.M`, verified: `docs/BUILD-PLAN.md:95,241,242,243`, `docs/REVIEW-2026-08-28.md:218`, `docs/adr/0008:47`, `docs/adr/0015:70`, `docs/adr/0022:11` (§4.1), `docs/adr/0023:9,33`, `docs/adr/0024:26`, `docs/adr/0028:12` (§3.6). So `§1.2/2`, `§1.2/3`, `§2.1`, `§3.6` and `§4.1` must still be the sections they are today. Renumber nothing, merge no sections, split none.

Numbers are measurements and are copied, never recomputed: 201 commits / 11 calendar days / 45 commits on the peak day, 22 commits/day over 9 active days, 8,892 dashboard lines against `core`'s 13,352, 41 minutes human-active with 18 reading diffs, the scores in `REVIEW`'s §0 table (9/10, 7/10, 6/10, 6/10). If a sentence reads as wrong, translate it as it stands — these are dated records of what was judged on those days.

**The two in-document markers are prose and get translated with everything else.** `PLAYBOOK.md` uses **→ ADR** in five places to mark a correction that binds only through an ADR; keep the arrow and the letters, it is already English. `REVIEW-2026-08-29.md` uses **[KARAR]** in three places for an item that needs a ruling; it becomes **[DECISION]** in all three, and nothing outside that file greps for the word (checked).

**Register.** Match the English already in `docs/` — `REVIEW-2026-08-28.md` is the same kind of document by the same author and is the model. Short sentences, verdict first. Turkish `Hüküm:` opens a ruling; render it `Ruling:` and keep the bold. `Kapı` in `PLAYBOOK.md §2.2` is the gate the rest of the repository already calls a gate.

**Three things stay Turkish; do not touch them.** The fixtures in `packages/core/src/id.ts` and `packages/core/src/id.test.ts` (`Ayrıştırma` → `ayristirma`) are the transliteration table's whole point. The author's name in `LICENSE`, `packages/cli/LICENSE`, `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` and the three `plugin.json` files is a name. And `docs/M1-GATE.md:46` quotes the letter `ı` inside an English sentence about NFD decomposition — that is English prose, leave the line alone.

Nothing outside `docs/` changes: no code, no test, no CI file.

acceptance.proves: No tracked file contains Turkish prose any more. Run today this lists exactly docs/PLAYBOOK.md and docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md and nothing else, so it goes green only when both are rewritten.
No Turkish-only letter is left outside the three deliberate exclusions — the name, the transliteration fixtures, and the English sentence in M1-GATE.md that quotes the letter itself.

acceptance.run: for s in 1.2 2.1 3.6 4.1; do grep -q "^### $s\|^## $s" docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md || { echo "§$s is gone"; exit 1; }; done && echo sections intact
acceptance.proves: The four section numbers the ADRs and BUILD-PLAN.md cite still exist in the rewritten review — the eight incoming §N.M references still resolve.

acceptance.run: git diff --stat main -- docs/ packages/ apps/ scripts/ .github/
acceptance.proves: Only docs/PLAYBOOK.md and docs/REVIEW-2026-08-29.md changed: no code, no test, no CI file was touched, and neither document was renamed.
